scope: Read-only primary-source supplement to existing MATURE01-03 / CHATREAD visual acceptance; no implementation or compliance conclusion.

references.title: WAI APG Disclosure
references.fact: Disclosure controls toggle content with Enter or Space and expose expanded state; aria-controls is optional.

references.title: WAI APG Menu Button
references.fact: A menu button opens a menu and moves focus to a menu item. Its popup role and managed menu keyboard behavior are part of the pattern.

references.title: WCAG 2.2 Understanding 4.1.3 Status Messages
references.fact: Displayed action, waiting, progress and error status updates must be programmatically determinable without forcing focus. A user-triggered disclosure state change is not itself a new status message. Excessive live-region feedback can disrupt users.

flowInferences: A single details affordance containing rich activity, radios, paging and ordinary buttons should keep disclosure semantics; do not apply role menu merely because the design calls it More. A separate true command menu must retain its actual menu focus model.
Keep actionable queue/receipt errors and their status/alert semantics available while compacting successful routine detail; do not wrap every row or the entire transcript in a new alert region.
A collapsed-to-expanded state already communicates expansion; avoid announcing the whole loaded tool body as a new status. Keep lazy-body behavior independently verified.
Focus and announcements require actual browser/assistive-tech validation by the eventual owner; these source references are not a conformance certificate.
